source.selection: First 50 distinct filename-sorted CR3 files, frame_000 through frame_049. Contiguous optical focus frames; no repeated file or upscale. Partial dataset acquisition, not complete 999-frame source.

full_raw_decode.original_precision: 14-bit sensor samples stored in uint16; nonzero low eight bits verified in all 50 raw visible planes. Does not claim 16-bit sensor ADC.
full_raw_decode.scope: Corpus qualification with reference LibRaw only. Not Rust decoder qualification, Pancake conformance, or performance baseline.
full_raw_decode.T50_exclusion: Native visible 5118x3412 is below required 6000x4000. No resizing or 8-bit promotion fills T50.
